rows.definition: A declared physical memory allocation pool with an identity and usable capacity for model placement accounting.
rows.distinction: Capacity input shared by ranks, unlike PoolDemand which reports summed allocations against that capacity.

rows.definition: A model placement omission indicating that the usable capacity of a referenced physical memory pool was not supplied.
rows.distinction: An unknown input yields no capacity approval; it differs from a known pool capacity being exceeded and from the capacity value itself.

rows.definition: The placement planner value declaring that the requested model placement lacks runtime support in the caller supplied execution envelope.
rows.distinction: A caller declaration that prevents eligibility even when memory fits; it is neither a hardware qualification result nor a capacity overflow.
